Rae: PR #4765 updates Console observability: adds a compact cost+latency dashboard preset, tweaks the trace hook examples for the trace_id key, and fixes a couple of stale links. Need someone to run smoke/linkcheck and quick snippet polish. @DevEx Jake?
DevEx Jake: Happy to. Paste the staging preview please.
Rae: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4765/preview. Notes: preset includes cost.by_route, latency.heatmap, and a tiny kv-prefetch example. Trace hook param renamed from traceKey -> trace_id across snippets.
Jon (eng): Quick check: runtime has a compatibility shim on v2.1+ that accepts traceKey. We should call that out so users on older agents see the safe path.
SRE Mina: Agreed. Also requested a small microbench for the preset numbers so the docs blurb has sensible illustrative values.
Lina (product): Suggested before/after example: "Before: median 125ms / p99 290ms / est cost $0.0052. After kv-prefetch: median 98ms / p99 240ms / est cost $0.0042" with a clear caveat.
DevEx Jake: Running smoke/linkcheck now: ```./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4765 --suite quick --linkcheck```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4765 -> staging (ETA ~2m)
DevEx Jake: Smoke: PASS. Linkcheck: 1 broken anchor (tracehook-deepdive#examples). Left PR comment.
Rae: I'll patch the anchor and add a redirect note to the trace-hook migration section. Also adding a short migration snippet mapping ctx.traceKey -> ctx.trace_id in Node, Python, and Go.
Jon (eng): Snippet thumbs-up. For Go show context.Value mapping. For Node show span.setTag rename.
SRE Mina: Microbench (summary): median down ~22%, p99 down ~17%, token cost per request down ~13%. Pushed numbers to the PR and added a small table in the preset docs.
Lina (product): Nice. Can you also add a one-line checklist: "Upgrade SDKs to v3.4+ for auto-mapping; otherwise replace traceKey -> trace_id."
Rae: Added checklist, patched links, and pushed snippet formatting fixes. Requested reviews from @DevEx Jake, @SRE Mina, @Jon (eng).
DevEx Jake: LGTM after CI finishes. Re-ran linkcheck -> all green.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 4765 -> staging (status: success)
Rae: Merged to main and backported to 3.x docs. Closing thread 389 thanks everyone!
